strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Our universe's winds have stirred... So, they have come. Living things
survive only when they know the space in which they belong.
...Fools who know not their place...
Heh... Hasn't changed since last time.
Yeah... And here I thought we'd never come back...
Fujiwara... Are you certain this is the place?
Think there's more than one place like this? It's Muge's... red universe.
Another world... Is it really this creepy...?
If it were more romantic, we could have a date with no one in the way...
Suit yourself.
I'd advise against it. Other dimensions rarely bring anything good.
I agree. I saw the same among Gades's men...
It's a mad world, born of twisted hearts.
I see. Now that you mention it, this place reeks
of evil.
...That's how it is. Ryo, Sara, Masato! Let's go!
Cyber Beast Force! Don't just...
Easy, Captain Bright. We know this place better than you, y'know.
What shall we do... Bright?
...We'll have to stand by. They're the only ones who know this place.
A red... universe? What the hell is this place?
Getting dragged somewhere like this all of a sudden...
Fujiwara and the others... were here before?
What a...
Sure, it looks red, but...
...What is this place? It's creepy...
And there are weird rocks floating around...
No enemies...?
If there's nothing here... can we leave? It gives me the creeps...
...No... This place is filled with a presence... a deeply evil one.
Eek... D-Don't say scary stuff like that!
But... I've got a bad feeling.
You feel it too...? Roll.
If you ask me, it'd be weirder if nothing was here.
...Meaning...?
So... you've tracked this place down after all...!
That's... the fake Dancougar...! ...Shapiro... We meet again...!
Heh... Are you glad, Sara...?
...Yeah. Because here... I can finally settle things
with you...!
Sara...
You've grown strong, Sara. But... that strength will soon be
meaningless...
Go ahead and try! I won't... hesitate anymore.
Indeed... Hesitation must be cut away.
Bright, I'm heading out.
Hey, Kyosuke?
...Yeah. This feeling... It could be...
One enemy, the Fake Dancougar... Stay sharp! All hands, launch!
Aestivalis squad, prepare to launch too!
Don't get careless, everyone!
We've gotta get back to Earth...! We can't dawdle in a place like this!
We're heading out too.
Okey-dokey!
You bastard, I've been listening, and you sure have a lot to say!
Your time is up... Prepare yourself!
Heheheh... I'll return those very words to you.
Tch, now what're you pulling ou-- Ugh!?
That's...!
The space monster Gilgilgan...! What's it doing here!?
Wait... We saw that thing on the plant planet before...!
Shapiro Keats! What is the meaning of this!?
Heheh... Space monster Gilgilgan... They're flocking to this universe...
Do you understand what that means? Heheheh...
What...!?
They are the remnants. The dregs.
The dregs...? Of what!?
...Of the Einst, right?
Most likely.
The Einst!? But they look nothing alike...
Perhaps it's their essence that's the same.
?? You mean... on the inside?
...Could it be...
Brother?
I'm not certain... But we may be the same
as those space monsters.
Whoa, whoa, don't lump us in with something that vicious!
Rom, you don't mean...
It's only a possibility, Jet.
Hm? Oh...
Huh!? What's that supposed to mean!?
Excellen! You mean...!?
...What's your connection to the Einst series?
It is beyond anything you could imagine... truly the realm of the gods.
Mere mortals cannot understand.
You've got the face of someone who knows it all, Shapiro!
Naturally. I am not like you. ...Heh, but still... Woman, if I recall, you were
with this Einst series...
So what if I was? ...Geez, that's a sore spot for me, you know.
...Of all humans... you understand them the best... You are a dangerous
woman...
A dangerous... woman!? ...That actually sounds kinda cool...
Weren't you just saying it was a sore spot?
Oops, so I was.
No matter... This is where you all end. Leave the rest to me... Heheheh.
The rest?
Shapiro Keats... He seems to have plans of his own...
but we won't be finished off so easily.
No... You are finished. ...Attack!
All units, commence attack! We cannot lose this battle...!
Ohhhhhh! Let's do this!!
This time we must have finished him...!
...Wait for me in hell... Shapiro.
...Heheheh... Sara... Either way... you too will fall into hell...
I've had enough of your sore-loser talk, Shapiro!
Sore loser...? Me...? Heh... No... All who live in this universe...
all of them... every one...
What're you trying to say!?
Your role... is over.
Impossible... Not once, but twice! I mastered ultimate evolution, so...
They say the ultimate evolution is extinction... Then it suits you well.
Is it... over!?
The aura of malice... is fading...! It's over!
The ultimate... Wasn't that why... I was chosen...
No... You were never the one chosen...
What... You are...
Everything... is for... the new... you see...
Oh... Ohhhhhhh!
Ah...
You idiot... You really are an idiot, Shapiro...!
It's over for now, at least.
Sara... Don't be too hard on yourself.
Quit tiptoeing around me.
Things between him and me... ended a long time ago.
Right, Shinobu?
Huh? Oh... Yeah, I guess.
A woman's gotta be strong. Right, Kyosuke?
Shapiro Keats should have had Emperor Muge backing him...
He's not even listening...!
Yes... If the Muge universe hasn't collapsed...
then he's lurking nearby...
Where... will he come from!?
...We're being watched... I can feel it...
Hm... Something's here...!?
Huh, what? Kamille?
The Inspector...!!
Excellen, calm down. You should be all right now.
...Okay.
Damn, that thing again...
Einst Regisseur... was it?
...Isn't it showing up more and more often?
I figured that thing was the mystery enemy... the boss
of the Einst series...
Yeah, that's what the tablet Hibiki's father found said.
But that was ages ago, right?
There's something... above this thing...?
Here they come!
Everyone! Intercept them!
Fujiwara!
Can't you see something nasty's coming!? Save it for later!
Just listen! Muge Zorbados...
is most likely nearby...!
What!?
...A reading from data you brought back before has appeared nearby.
Enjoying the show, huh? What a jerk.
Commander, where is he!?
...This space is far more distorted than normal space...
Pinpointing him is difficult, but be careful!
Can't you find him from there either!?
No. Omoikane says it hasn't got a clue either.
Hiding and watching, huh? What a creep...!
But for now, our enemy is right in front of us!
Right, losing to this thing would make it all meaningless! Stay focused!
...Muge, you bastard...! Just wait. Once I smash this thing,
I'm dragging you out of hiding!
Role...!? What role!?
His own? Or...
Could it be... me?
...My gut says... no.
Fwahahaha... I had thought to watch you all
a while longer...
...It has been a while... you fools who take the name of God in vain...!
So that's... Muge... Muge Zorbados!?
Fujiwara!
No doubt about it... It's him... that Muge bastard...!
One we destroyed has returned... What is going on...?
Do you not see? The universe has need of me
once again...!
Enough of your delusions, you lowly invader!
Cut the gibberish! First Shapiro, now you...
What're you getting at!?
I told you before, on Earth. I am the universe itself... and I would lead
you foolish humans into my world...
Unfortunately... I'd rather pass on such a remote little world...!
Quite so. It hardly seems a pleasant place for a stroll.
Emperor Muge, we've never met... but back to darkness you go...!
With the Danku Sword... once again...!
Fools... Such utter fools, Earthlings! In that sense... Shapiro Keats...
may have been the only Earthling who ever realized it.
Shapiro... him!?
The universe desires evolution... It can't expect that of Earthlings.
Ugh... Ungh...
Excellen!?
Don't give me that! There are people like Dr. Saotome, who
researching Getter Rays to open new paths of evolution for humanity--
people like that...!
...If you mock that... I won't forgive you...
Heh... Hahahahahahaha! Flesh, perish!
Huh? What's he saying all of a sudden!?
...Because... they're bound... by the flesh...
H-Hey, Excellen...?
...Beyond the beast, beyond human wisdom, to become a god...
That is the best evolution you could manage...
Super Beast... Machine God...
Commander Hazuki... no, the answer Dr. Hazuki
arrived at...!
If that is the wish you entrusted to Dancougar...
then that is the bottomless ignorance of Earthlings...
Because...!
Because...?
Don't... listen... Captain...!
Hey!
...Because the ultimate form of your ideal evolution, Earthlings...
is I...!
Wha...!
The ultimate evolution? ...Of Earthlings!?
That is exactly right...
...Alchemie...!
Long time no see, little girl.
...Muge Zorbados is one form that human evolution can take...
It is what we have been seeking, Kyosuke.
...Do you really believe that?
...What... do you mean...?
He means, are those really your own words?
Hey, what's going on!? Did you figure something out!?
Her own... words...?
If you're the one seeking the form of human evolution...
you should give it up.
Why... Why would you say such a thing? Kyosuke, I...
...If you want the ultimate that badly... then basing it on humans
is a mistake, you know... my other... self.
I see...! So that girl is really...!!
Excellen's...!?
...Why you're so fixated on me... I had a hunch.
Heheheh... Ultimate evolution, and basing it on humans
is a mistake, you say?
Wrong. All the weak, unfinished parts of humanity...
stripped away... That is what I am.
Like I care.
Shinobu...?
Muge, you bastard, I dunno if what you're saying is true or not.
And I couldn't care less who or what the Einst brat is, or what she wants.
...But you lot aren't just enemies of us Earthlings...
you're enemies of this whole universe...! That's why I fight...!
Why can't you understand that this very thinking is what throws
this universe into chaos...?
Because the universe wills it.
The universe...?
Every living thing in this universe... the righteous and the wicked alike...
is permitted to live. To live, and to pass on to the children who follow
the way they lived... that is why the fighting goes on.
That's right...! That's why Raideen lends me its power
for that very purpose...!
The brave Raideen... Yes, of course...
Long ago, so its dangerous power would not pass on, the Mu Empire was
to vanish from the earth... yet it could only be sunk beneath the sea,
and that was because...
And what was recorded back then... was the tablet in those ruins.
Heheheh... Enough. With the power of the Einst now mine...
you fools have trespassed upon my sanctuary in the universe,
and angered me. I'll make you regret it!
Ultimate evolution!? Who decided what's ultimate!?
Any guy who can shamelessly call himself the ultimate, I sure as hell
won't accept...! Let's do this!
Let's settle this...!
...At last... the time has come...
I don't know what you were testing, but no such time will come.
...Consider it mercy. I'll bury you in one blow, Alchemie.
Now do you see? Ultimate evolution... Before everyone's feelings,
a thing like that means nothing at all, you know...?
I don't understand... I don't understand at all...
No way! It escaped... with that much damage!
Ruri!
...Lost it. Or rather, in this space, radar and the like
are completely useless.
...Alchemie...
...You know, Excellen. Given what she was "created" for...
there's no way in the world we can save her...
...Yeah...
We did it... This time... we really did it.
Yeah, though none of it made any sense.
No time to relax! Now it's...!
...At last... the time has come...
I don't know what you were testing, but no such time will come.
...You're next, Alchemie.
Now do you see? Ultimate evolution... a thing like that,
before everyone's feelings, means nothing at all, you know...?
I don't understand... I don't understand at all...
It escaped!
Ruri!
...Lost it. Or rather, in this space, radar and the like
are completely useless.
...Alchemie...
...You know, Excellen. Given what she was "created" for...
there's no saving her...
...Yeah...
That red machine's gone too... So that means it's over?
Yeah... Ultimate evolution? Gimme a break.
Hazuki, what is the matter...?
Ultimate evolution... If Emperor Muge truly is that...
then perhaps the direction we scientists aimed for was wrong.
Commander...
...The evolution of man. The innovation of man, is it?
...Alchemie... that girl...
...Excellen, don't think about it now.
Hey, what've you two been whispering about this whole time?
Hm? Oh, come on, Judau. That talk's a little too grown-up for you.
What's that supposed to mean?
Whaaat? Kyosuke did? Really?
...Let's just leave it at that.
